# kcore_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

Kubernetes cluster (`kctl kubernetes apply`). The local provisioner is `shared` (directories on one formatted volume) or `lvm` (one thin pool per node, no volume provisioner). Destroy deletes the cluster record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_kubernetes_cluster" "lab" {
  name                      = "lab"
  cluster_cidr              = "10.244.0.0/16"
  service_cidr              = "10.96.0.0/12"
  api_server_endpoint       = "192.168.40.220:6443"
  schedule_on_control_plane = true

  control_plane_node {
    node_id           = "node-107"
    advertise_address = "192.168.40.107"
    initial_cluster   = true
  }

  cilium {
    load_balancer_ip_pool = ["192.168.40.220/29"]
  }

  # shared: format one volume and install the local-path provisioner.
  local_provisioner {
    enabled            = true
    mode               = "shared"
    storage_class_name = "local-path"

    volume {
      name          = "kcore-kdata"
      node_id       = "node-107"
      storage_class = "lvm"
      size_bytes    = "53687091200"
      fs_type       = "ext4"
      role          = "filesystem"
    }
  }
}

resource "kcore_kubernetes_cluster" "pools" {
  name                = "pools"
  cluster_cidr        = "10.245.0.0/16"
  service_cidr        = "10.112.0.0/12"
  api_server_endpoint = "192.168.40.201:7443"

  control_plane_node {
    node_id           = "node-105"
    advertise_address = "192.168.40.105"
    initial_cluster   = true
  }

  high_availability {
    enabled       = true
    vip_address   = "192.168.40.201"
    vip_interface = "enp6s0"
  }

  # lvm: one thin pool on every member. kcore does not install a volume provisioner.
  local_provisioner {
    enabled            = true
    mode               = "lvm"
    storage_class_name = "kcore-lvm"

    volume {
      name          = "kcore-kdata"
      node_id       = "node-105"
      storage_class = "lvm"
      size_bytes    = "53687091200"
      role          = "pool"
      volume_group  = "vg_kcore"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `api_server_endpoint` (String) VIP or node address and port, for example 192.168.40.220:6443.
- `cluster_cidr` (String)
- `control_plane_node` (Block List, Min: 1) Control-plane members. The first node bootstraps etcd. Adding or changing a node calls ScaleKubernetesCluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--control_plane_node))
- `name` (String)
- `service_cidr` (String)

### Optional

- `cilium` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cilium))
- `cluster_dns` (String)
- `cni` (String)
- `force` (Boolean) Pass force when deleting the cluster.
- `high_availability` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--high_availability))
- `local_provisioner` (Block List, Max: 1) Host storage for PersistentVolumeClaims. mode shared installs the local-path provisioner. mode lvm creates one thin pool on each member and does not install a provisioner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--local_provisioner))
- `schedule_on_control_plane` (Boolean) Control-plane nodes accept pods. Worker nodes may be empty.
- `worker_node` (Block List) Worker members. Adding or changing a node calls ScaleKubernetesCluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--worker_node))

### Read-Only

- `api_server_reachable` (Boolean)
- `etcd_healthy` (Boolean)
- `etcd_member_count` (Number)
- `generation` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_health` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_health))
- `overall_health` (String)
- `phase` (String)
- `ready_control_planes` (Number)
- `ready_workers` (Number)
- `status_message` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--local_provisioner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local_provisioner`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `mode` (String) shared or lvm. Empty means shared.
- `storage_class_name` (String) Empty means local-path.
- `volume` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--local_provisioner--volume))

<a id="nestedblock--local_provisioner--volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local_provisioner.volume`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `node_id` (String) Must be a control-plane or worker member of this cluster.
- `size_bytes` (String)
- `storage_class` (String)

Optional:

- `fs_type` (String) ext4 or xfs. Empty means ext4.
- `mount_path` (String) Empty means /mnt/kcore/<cluster>/<name>. Leave empty for an lvm pool.
- `role` (String) filesystem in shared mode, pool in lvm mode.
- `volume_group` (String) Required when role is pool.
